newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand approves 28 new insurance cos licences.
newsitem.headline: Thailand approves 28 new insurance cos licences.

text.p: Thailand's cabinet on Tuesday approved the licensing of a total of 28 new life and non-life insurance companies, a government minister said.
Of the total, 12 licences would be for life insurance companies and 16 would be for non-life insurance firms, the Minister for University Affairs, Montree Danpaiboon, told reporters.
The capital requirement for new life insurance companies would be 500 million baht ($19.2 million) and for non-life insurance firms it would be 300 million baht, he said.
No further details were available but an official statement was expected later.
